productions.notes: Nested action usages in an action definition body, including SourceSuccessionMember 'then action'.
';' | '{' ActionBodyItem* '}'; declarations with and without a body must both parse.
OccurrenceDefinitionPrefix 'action' 'def' DefinitionDeclaration ActionBody; semicolon and brace bodies both parse.
One exclusive slot: `abstract` | `variation`. Pairing both keywords has no spelling and is recovered rather than parsed as two modifiers.
owned ConnectorEndMember 'to' ConnectorEndMember.
SysML is 'bind' / 'binding' UsageDeclaration 'bind'. KerML 'binding … of … =' recovers in a SysML fence.
`~` QualifiedName; the fixture types a port as ~Power and publishes conjugated typing.
OccurrenceDefinitionPrefix 'connection' 'def' Definition, including end members.

SysML spellings are 'connect' / 'connection … connect'. KerML 'connector … from … to' recovers. The keyword-less n-ary alternative 'connect (e1, e2, e3)' recovers in a part definition body; named 'connection … connect (…)' parses.
isEnd ?= 'end' Usage inside an interface definition body.
';' | '{' DefinitionBodyItem* '}'; declarations with and without a body must both parse.
IfNode has no 'then' keyword; ActionBodyParameter is always a braced body (SysML BNF 1123-1138). The shorthand `if <cond> then <a> else <b>;` is not a production.
';' | '{' InterfaceBodyItem* '}'; semicolon and brace bodies both parse.
'interface' 'def' DefinitionDeclaration InterfaceBody; a connect clause belongs on InterfaceUsage, not the definition.
Parenthesized ends parse on 'connection … connect (e1, e2, e3)'. The ConnectionUsage alternative 'connect (e1, e2, e3)' recovers in a part definition body because that dispatcher is binary-only.
OccurrenceDefinitionPrefix 'part' 'def' Definition; semicolon and brace bodies are both DefinitionBody.
OccurrenceUsagePrefix 'part' Usage; nested usages parse inside a part definition body.
DefinitionPrefix 'port' 'def' Definition; semicolon and brace bodies are both DefinitionBody.
OccurrenceUsagePrefix 'port' Usage, including nested ports in a port definition body.
Variance slot is `abstract` | `variation`; `constant` is a separate optional. SysML has no `var`/`variable` keyword.
'then' before an ActionBehaviorMember.
'first' ConnectorEndMember 'then' ConnectorEndMember inside an action body.
EffectBehaviorMember (`do`) is before TransitionSuccessionMember (`then`).
Feature typing is `:` / `typed by`. Classifier `specializes` is TypeDeclaration, not FeatureDeclaration.
